name: flowlines
description: Flowlines agent observability: analyse your Flowlines workspace over MCP and instrument MCP servers with the Flowlines telemetry contract.

interface.shortDescription: Agent observability for MCP servers and coding agents
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to your Flowlines workspace over MCP so you can ask what your agents' users did, what changed since a release, and where sessions go wrong. Bundles skills that instrument an MCP server with the Flowlines telemetry contract and run repeatable analyses: weekly review, release check, session investigation, cohort building, and ingestion diagnostics.
defaultPrompt: What changed in my Flowlines namespace this week?
Use $flowlines-mcp-observability to instrument this MCP server.
Use $flowlines-doctor to find out why my sessions are not showing up in Flowlines.
